content.title: About
content.content: Decaffeinated iced latte is a cold beverage made from espresso, milk, and ice, using beans that have had most of their caffeine removed. It retains the characteristic aroma and flavor of a classic latte while lacking the stimulating effect of caffeine.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Decaffeination is usually performed by water or CO₂ methods, preserving most flavor compounds.
Decaf iced latte is popular among people who avoid caffeine for medical reasons or sensitivity.
Sugar content depends on added syrups; many versions use sweeteners to balance bitterness.
Serving cold enhances perceived sweetness and aroma, making the drink especially refreshing in warm weather.
In some countries decaffeinated coffee is classified as a separate product category with its own quality standards.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Decaffeinated beans retain polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports hydration
items.content: The high water and milk content of the drink contributes to overall fluid balance.

items.title: Rich in calcium
items.content: Milk provides a good source of calcium, essential for bones and teeth.

items.title: Low caffeine content
items.content: Suitable for individuals who need to limit caffeine but still want the coffee taste.

items.title: Provides vitamin B2
items.content: Riboflavin present in milk and coffee participates in energy metabolism.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People with lactose intolerance or milk allergy should opt for plant‑based milk alternatives.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Added syrups can increase calories and affect blood glucose levels.

items.title: Loss of some aromatic compounds
items.content: The decaffeination process may reduce certain flavor molecules, making the taste less intense.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the decaf iced latte chilled over ice; optionally add flavored syrups, vanilla, or a sprinkle of cinnamon. Plant‑based milks (almond, oat) can be used for a vegan version.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the prepared drink in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours. Keep decaffeinated coffee beans in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place.
